svg.title: Dual Arduino Nano architecture
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing Nano 2 (control) on the left and Nano 1 (telemetry) on the right, connected by a UART framed packet bus, each with their own dedicated IMU and responsibilities.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the dedicated IMU placement for TVC')
sendPrompt('Walk me through the flight state machine transitions')
sendPrompt('How does the PID controller drive the TVC servos?')
sendPrompt('How does the parachute failsafe timer work?')
sendPrompt('What does the UART framed packet protocol look like?')
sendPrompt('Does Nano 1 need its own IMU or can it share?')
sendPrompt('How does the telemetry buffer work?')
sendPrompt('How does the SD card writer handle flush timing?')
sendPrompt('How are state change events annotated in the log?')
sendPrompt('How does the UART receiver state machine work on Nano 1?')
